description: Add past time that was not timed: minutes (ending now, or at end), or start+end as HH:MM on date. For calls, children, workout, paid work, or work done away from the agent, or a calendar event that happened (pass its calendar_event_id: the same event is never logged twice). Apps replaying a queued entry pass op_id, so a retry does not count the time twice.

calendar_event_id.description: the id of the calendar event this time comes from, as your calendar connector gives it (for one occurrence of a recurring event, that occurrence's id); an event already logged is refused

exclusive.description: true: nothing else was happening then

op_id.description: for apps replaying queued requests: an id the app minted before its first attempt and reuses on retries, so the write is applied once and a retry gets the first answer back. Do not invent one; an agent calling interactively leaves it out

weight.description: attention weight vs other sessions at the same time, default 1
